messages:
rina: Quick alert  Wave-52 H200s stuck at Salalah transload yard due to stowage reassessment. Forwarder says container needs rework before continuing.
rina: These are earmarked for pool-global-edge as RMA replacements + topoff. Need routing decision.
vendor-orbit: Confirmed: Salalah yard flagged excess weight on outer tier, port requires re-stow or export hold ~36\t60h. Two vendor options: 1) local re-stow (36\t60h + yard fee), or 2) transload to DXB and air-split priority 6 units to LHR/AMS (expedite +16% freight).
marc: Cost/benefit? If we lose capacity for EU edge it's SLA-impacting. What is the uplift + handling for air via DXB?
vendor-orbit: Rough estimate: freight uplift +16% on base, handling $560/unit at DXB, provisional insurance +1.0% declared. Transload fee at SAL: $1,200 flat if you choose re-stow.
claire: Customs note  moving via DXB requires updated export docs and ATA carnets if treated as samples. Also confirm ECCN; UK/EU import will need correct classification.
rina: Preference: keep as many units on sea if re-stow time <48h. Otherwise air-split 6 critical units to LHR and leave rest for sea. Vendor please include REDWOOD-RMA in manifest ref so we can auto-claim.
vendor-orbit: Will add REF:REDWOOD-RMA|PO:2024-9401 to manifest refs. Provisional AWBs for air leg if chosen:
AWB: 880-4409001
AWB: 880-4409002
AWB: 880-4409003
AWB: 880-4409004
AWB: 880-4409005
AWB: 880-4409006
vendor-orbit: We'll also append 5 return RMA labels for flagged DOA units into the upload and provide a portal link: https://vendor.orbit.example.com/rma/labels?ref=REDWOOD-2024-9401
marc: Finance  please approve conditional air uplift to PO# 2024-9401 for up to +16% freight and handling lines. Also require vendor credit clause: any serial mismatch >1 unit triggers immediate replacement credit.
claire: Ops ask  when AWBs are posted, can ops run the earmark script to pin units into pool-global-edge? snippet:
```
# earmark replacements
python ops/earmark.py --pool pool-global-edge --ref REDWOOD-RMA --awbs 880-4409001,880-4409002,880-4409003,880-4409004,880-4409005,880-4409006
```
ops-bot: Ticket created: ORB-2024-9944 "Salalah stow -> DXB transload / air-split decision". Assigned to @rina and vendor-orbit.
vendor-orbit: If Salalah re-stow extends >60h we recommend diversion to MCT air-hub as fallback (slightly cheaper ground leg than DXB, +12% uplift vs base). We'll include cost delta in invoice addendum.
marc: Can vendor ensure serial CSV attached to the AWB upload? inventory needs serials to auto-assign to pool. Missing serials on arrival will be a big pain.
vendor-orbit: Affirmative  serial CSV and crate dims/weights will be uploaded in ~90m. We'll hold final invoice until ops confirms route.
rina: Also request RMA pickup instructions included in manifest for the 3 DOA units we flagged earlier so we can do direct swap at dock. That avoids quarantine.
vendor-orbit: Will include return pickup SLA and labels. Portal: https://vendor.orbit.example.com/rma/submit?ref=REDWOOD-2024-9401
claire: Copy. Facilities will prep for LHR/AMS dock slots if air-split confirmed. Please include crate jaw width and pallet height in the upload.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 12h check-in on ORB-2024-9944.
rina: OK thanks. Keep docs in this thread only. :thumbsup: vendor-orbit: uploading docs in ~90m.
